text:
jordan (release-manager): deploy-bot failed to promote artifact to prod, blocking the release. checksum mismatch for redwood-inference-api:v2026-03-20-rc2. attaching bot log below. can we triage quickly?

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] attempt=1 env=prod service=redwood-inference-api image=registry.redwood.io/redwood-inference-api:v2026-03-20-rc2
ERROR: artifact checksum mismatch: expected sha256:abc1234f... but got sha256:def4567a...
Action: promotion aborted, rolling back staging tag.
See: registry.redwood.io/artifacts/redwood-inference-api/v2026-03-20-rc2/manifest.json

alice (eng): ugh. CI build passed on master earlier though. could this be an upload/race to the registry? :thinking:

ben (build): CI job `publish-artifact` shows success at 11:02:12, but the storage backend reported a 200 while the checksum verification failed during promote. possible S3 eventual consistency or multipart upload reassembly issue.

maya (sre): we had similar S3 inode/multi-part flakiness last month (SEE: SRE-issue-789). quick options: 1) rerun publish with `--no-cache` and verify checksum before promotion, 2) pin to previous prod tag and open a hotfix build.

jordan (release-manager): change window for production is in 30m. we need a decision: hold the release and rollback to prod v2026-03-18, or re-run publish now and try to promote within window?

alice (eng): I'd prefer re-run publish now with `--no-cache` and `sha256sum` verification step added to pipeline, then promote if checksums match. avoids rollback churn but risks missing window.

ben (build): I'll trigger a manual rerun of `publish-artifact` with `--no-cache` now. also adding an explicit `sha256sum` artifact file to the build output. kicking off: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/1234/console

ci-bot: [JOB STARTED] job=publish-artifact build=1234 triggered_by=ben (build)

deploy-bot: note: promotion will remain blocked until the artifact digest matches. if new artifact is pushed with same tag, promotion will re-evaluate.

maya (sre): also recommending we pin the release in the release tracker and update release notes: add note that original rc2 failed checksum and we're re-running to verify. jordan, can you update the release page?

jordan (release-manager): updating release tracker and adding blocker note referencing JIRA-1234. holding canary until CI confirmation. if rerun fails, we rollback to v2026-03-18 and schedule a follow-up postmortem.

ben (build): build 1234 finished. upload step shows artifact sha256: abc1234f... (matches local), registry manifest now reports same digest. triggering promote attempt 2.

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] attempt=2 env=prod service=redwood-inference-api image=registry.redwood.io/redwood-inference-api:v2026-03-20-rc2
SUCCESS: manifest digest verified sha256:abc1234f...
Promotion complete.

jordan (release-manager): great. releasing now. will leave canary on for 1 hour and watch metrics. creating a small follow-up action: add forced checksum verification to publish pipeline (ticket CI-2245). :rocket:
